Tritium breeding ratio (TBR) – WCLL blanket

Interactive XGBoost surrogate model (R² = 0.998 on the test set). Pick the blanket geometry with the sliders and explore the TBR as a function of 6Li enrichment and PbLi fraction.

Tap or hover on the map to read the predicted TBR.
TBR values are predictions of an XGBoost surrogate model (R² = 0.998 on the test set), precomputed on a grid and linearly interpolated between grid points. Dots are the Monte Carlo neutronics simulations of the database (2,023 runs). BM = breeding module, FW = first wall.
